newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-AC MILAN AND PORTO BATTLE TO 1-1 DRAW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AC MILAN AND PORTO BATTLE TO 1-1 DRAW.

text.p: Italian champions AC Milan edged closer to a place in the quarter-finals of the European Cup with a hard-fought 1-1 draw against Porto in their qualifying group D on Wednesday.
Dutch international Edgar Davids put Milan ahead after 55 minutes with a sweetly struck drive from a headed pass by Liberian striker George Weah.
But Porto, who had already qualified for the quarter-finals, quickly struck back through Brazilian midfielder Edmilson Pimenta.
Pimenta fired home after a goalmouth scramble in the 70th minute to give Porto, so far unbeaten in the competition, the draw they needed to finish top of the qualifying group.
